basic_profile.bio: I'm a 34-year-old gamer and tech enthusiast from Ontario, Canada. I've been a fan of the Fallout series since Fallout 3, and I love modding games to enhance my experience. When I'm not gaming, I work as a freelance graphic designer, and I also have a keen interest in retro gaming and DIY electronics. Although I'm single, I enjoy spending time with my close-knit group of gaming friends online. I'm usually active on Reddit in the evenings, especially after 8 PM EST.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a deep understanding of video game modding and mechanics, primarily learned through years of gaming and participation in gaming communities. I often stay updated on the latest mods and glitches through forums and YouTube channels. Additionally, my work as a graphic designer has given me a solid foundation in digital tools and software, which I occasionally apply to modding projects.
